name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a single 4px #005fcc focus ring with a 2px white box-shadow blur on every interactive element. This decision provides a clear visual indicator of focus for keyboard users while being subtle enough not to overwhelm sighted users. By choosing a single focus ring, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially less visual distinction between different types of interactive elements, but gaining consistency and simplicity in our design. This approach also aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, as it provides a clear and consistent way for users to navigate the site using their keyboard.

name: Reader
text: The single 4px ring fails on high-contrast modes—it disappears against white backgrounds. A double ring (4px #005fcc + 2px white inset) keeps visibility in all modes but risks clutter on dense interfaces. Test both in Windows High Contrast Mode and on a crowded mobile screen; the artifact is the test report.
